;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Second Nagorno-Karabakh War]], [[2020 Ganja ballistic missile attacks]]
**[[government of Azerbaijan|Azeri authorities]] say 13 civilians were killed and more than 40 others wounded by an [[Armed Forces of Armenia|Armenian]] [[Scud missile]] attack on [[Ganja, Azerbaijan]]. The [[Armenia]]n Defence Ministry says it is not true while [[Turkey]] calls the strike a "[[war crime]]". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/10/17/casualties-after-armenian-attack-targets-ganja-live-updates (Al Jazeera)]
**Azerbaijan says its troops have captured the city of [[Füzuli (city)|Füzuli]] in [[Nagorno-Karabakh]]. [[President of Azerbaijan|Azerbaijani President]] [[Ilham Aliyev]] tweets "Fuzuli city was liberated from the occupiers. Fuzuli is ours! Karabakh is Azerbaijan! I cordially congratulate all the people of Azerbaijan on this occasion." [https://en.trend.az/azerbaijan/politics/3318583.html (Trend)]
**Armenian [[Anti-aircraft warfare|air defences]] shoot down three Azerbaijani drones operating in its national airspace, according to the [[Ministry of Defence of Armenia]]. [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/world/armenian-air-defense-forces-down-3-azerbaijan-1059720.html (Urdupoint)]
**Armenia and Azerbaijan announce they are again attempting to establish a [[ceasefire]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/azerbaijan-armenia-attack-ceasefire-1.5766622 (CBC)]
*[[Iraqi insurgency (2017–present)]]
**At least eight [[Iraqis|Sunni Arabs]] are massacred by unknown men in [[Balad, Iraq|Balad]]. The area is controlled by the [[Asa'ib Ahl al-Haq]] militia prompting accusations against the militia. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-10/18/c_139448043.htm (Xinhua)] [https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/pro-iranian-militias-accused-of-attack-on-kurdish-party-civilians-in-iraq-646092 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on cinema]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)|COVID-19 pandemic in New York]]
**[[Governor of New York|New York Governor]] [[Andrew Cuomo]] announces that movie theaters in counties with no cluster zones in [[New York (state)|the state]] can reopen on October 23 with restrictions up to 25% in capacity with a maximum of 50 people per screen. However, movie theaters in [[New York City]] will remain closed. [https://variety.com/2020/film/news/andrew-cuomo-movie-theaters-open-outside-nyc-1234808492/ (''Variety'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 California wildfires]]
**According to the [[California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection]], [[California]] wildfires have consumed around 1 million acres (1,600 sq. miles) over the past month. This represents approximately 1% of California's land area. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/10/17/us/california-wildfires-saturday/index.html (CNN)]
;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports 10,925 new infections in the past 24 hours, a new record for a single day in the country since the pandemic began. As a result, [[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]] is slated to  announce new restrictions tomorrow. [https://www.corriere.it/salute/20_ottobre_17/coronavirus-italia-bollettino-oggi-17-ottobre-10925-nuovi-casi-47-morti-8ca75c06-1071-11eb-bf58-6564bb782bca.shtml?refresh_ce-cp (''Corriere della Sera'')] [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-italy-government/italy-to-announce-new-covid-19-restrictions-as-infections-spike-pms-office-idUKKBN2720LW?il=0 (Reuters)]
****[[Lombardy]] announces new restrictions ordering all bars closed at midnight effective today, with bars only able to serve customers seated at tables after 6 p.m. local time, and the sale of takeaway alcohol is also banned after that time. The region also prohibits the consumption of food and drink in all outside public areas under the new restrictions. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/europe/20201017-italy-s-northern-lombardy-region-orders-new-anti-virus-measures (RFI)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Austria]] reports 1,747 new infections in the past 24 hours, a new one-day record for the country since the pandemic began. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-austria-tally/austria-reports-record-daily-covid-19-infections-but-still-below-2000-idUSV9N2BU02B (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus]]
****[[Cyprus]] reports 202 new infections in the past 24 hours, a new record for the country that suggests the virus is spreading at a rapid pace as Cypriots fail to follow hygiene and social distancing protocols. [https://www.financialmirror.com/2020/10/17/covid-19-cyprus-cases-spiral-out-of-control-at-202/ (''Financial Mirror'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] reports a record 32,427 new cases in the past 24 hours as [[curfew]] goes into effect in [[Paris]] and other major cities in a bid to contain the outbreak. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-10-17/france-reports-record-32-427-new-coronavirus-cases-in-24-hours (Bloomberg)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****The number of new cases in [[Germany]] rises by 7,830 in the past 24 hours, a record for the third consecutive day. [https://www.dpa-international.com/topic/germany-coronavirus-caseload-jumps-7830-new-infections-urn%3Anewsml%3Adpa.com%3A20090101%3A201017-99-976056 (DPA International)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] reports a record 6,410 new cases in the past 24 hours, according to a statement from the [[National Security and Defense Council of Ukraine|NSDC]]. In addition, 109 patients have died in the past 24 hours, the highest daily death toll since the start of the [[pandemic]]. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/ukraine-s-new-daily-coronavirus-cases-exceed-6-000/46102952 (Swiss Info)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] surpasses 30,000 [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] deaths. [https://apnews.com/article/virus-outbreak-international-news-health-iran-b9089d14da45b32b04df670b6b7e1415 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports 869 new infections in the past 24 hours, its highest daily count so far since the beginning of the outbreak. Of these new cases, 451 cases were from [[Sabah]]. [https://www.nst.com.my/news/nation/2020/10/633070/spike-continues-whopping-869-new-covid-19-cases-today (''New Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports its first two locally transmitted cases of [[COVID-19]] in more than one month, after two [[Myanmar]] nationals living near the border with the country tested positive. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/thailand-first-local-covid-19-cases-in-over-a-month-oct-17-13298378 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]]
****[[Ministry of Information (Bangladesh)|Information Minister]] [[Hasan Mahmud (politician)|Hasan Mahmud]] is hospitalized at [[Square Hospital]] in [[Dhaka]] after testing positive for COVID-19. [https://bdnews24.com/bangladesh/2020/10/17/bangladesh-information-minister-hasan-mahmud-contracts-coronavirus (Bdnews24.com)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indiana]]
****[[Indiana]]'s Department of Health reports a record 2,521 new cases in a single day. That brings the state's cumulative total to 145,977 cases. This total includes 100 cases that were delayed in reporting "due to a technical issue." [https://www.indystar.com/story/news/health/2020/10/17/indiana-coronavirus-cases-2-521-new-cases-31-more-deaths-reported/3693198001/ (''The Indianapolis Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ohio]]
****[[Ohio]]'s Department of Health reports 2,234 new cases in the last 24 hours, which sets a new record for the fourth consecutive day. [https://www.wfmj.com/story/42780003/ohio-reports-single-largest-covid19-case-increase-saturday (WFMJ-TV)]
***The [[United States]] reports 70,450 new cases in the last 24 hours, the highest number since July 24. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2020/10/17/world/covid-coronavirus (''The New York Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Russia]] is to begin clinical trials of its [[Gam-COVID-Vac|Sputnik V]] vaccine in [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-russia-india-idUSKBN2720FF (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[End SARS]]
**The [[Nigerian Army]] announces a cyber warfare operation as protests against police brutality in the [[Nigeria|country]] continue. [https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/421439-breaking-nigerian-army-announces-cyberwarfare-operation-amidst-endsars-protests.html (''Premium Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 New Zealand general election]]
**Citizens of [[New Zealand]] head to the polls to elect the members of the country's [[New Zealand House of Representatives|House of Representatives]]. Next to the general election, the voters also decide about the country's policy regarding [[2020 New Zealand cannabis referendum|recreational marijuana]] and [[2020 New Zealand euthanasia referendum|euthanasia]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/oct/17/new-zealand-election-voters-head-to-the-polls-as-ardern-collins-call-halt-to-campaign (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Prime Minister of New Zealand|Prime Minister]] [[Jacinda Ardern]] wins a second term in a historic landslide. Ardern's [[New Zealand Labour Party|Labour Party]] becomes the first party to win a majority since the [[mixed-member proportional|proportional]] system was introduced in 1996. [https://www.tvnz.co.nz/one-news/new-zealand/labour-landslide-jacinda-ardern-sweeps-back-into-power-election-2020 (TVNZ)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/jacinda-ardern-wins-second-term-new-zealand-s-prime-minster-n1243816 (NBC News)]
